Protect all transaction references, including tombstones, every assignment row including zero values, and children. Child deletion retains its empty parent. No bank sync or financial cascade.
operations.permissions: Host-scoped SDK access; this callback is not remotely callable.
operations.scope: Host-supplied budget/environment context and personal/demo workspace where the method accepts it. Credentials remain machine-local.
errors: Missing/wrong-kind IDs, any referencing transaction/assignment or a parent with children are refused without mutation.
Authority/receipt/revision and uncertain-outcome protections apply.
operations.retry: The host owns one guarded intent. Reconcile uncertain outcomes using the exact original intent; never automatically create a new intent.
operations.availability: Optional additive CategoryDeletion SDK, WHAB 2.67+; true support also requires category_tree, atomic budget history and both mutation methods. Existing CategoryManagement is unchanged.
